campaign_recipients_phone_e164_valid.name: campaign_recipients_phone_e164_valid
campaign_recipients_phone_e164_valid.value:
length("campaign_recipients"."phone_e164") between 2 and 16
        and substr("campaign_recipients"."phone_e164", 1, 1) = '+'
        and substr("campaign_recipients"."phone_e164", 2, 1) between '1' and '9'
        and substr("campaign_recipients"."phone_e164", 2) not glob '*[^0-9]*'

campaign_recipients_error_code_valid.name: campaign_recipients_error_code_valid
campaign_recipients_error_code_valid.value:
"campaign_recipients"."last_error_code" is null
        or (
          length("campaign_recipients"."last_error_code") between 1 and 100
          and "campaign_recipients"."last_error_code" not glob '*[^A-Z0-9_]*'
        )

campaigns_key_sha256.name: campaigns_key_sha256
campaigns_key_sha256.value:
length("campaigns"."campaign_key") = 76
        and substr("campaigns"."campaign_key", 1, 12) = 'campaign_v1_'
        and substr("campaigns"."campaign_key", 13) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

campaigns_schedule_consistent.name: campaigns_schedule_consistent
campaigns_schedule_consistent.value:
(
        "campaigns"."delivery_mode" = 'immediate'
        and "campaigns"."scheduled_at" is null
      ) or (
        "campaigns"."delivery_mode" = 'scheduled'
        and length(trim("campaigns"."scheduled_at")) > 0
      )

campaigns_template_key_sha256.name: campaigns_template_key_sha256
campaigns_template_key_sha256.value:
length("campaigns"."template_key") = 76
        and substr("campaigns"."template_key", 1, 12) = 'template_v1_'
        and substr("campaigns"."template_key", 13) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

campaigns_error_code_valid.name: campaigns_error_code_valid
campaigns_error_code_valid.value:
"campaigns"."last_error_code" is null
        or (
          length("campaigns"."last_error_code") between 1 and 100
          and "campaigns"."last_error_code" not glob '*[^A-Z0-9_]*'
        )

contact_import_jobs_counts_valid.name: contact_import_jobs_counts_valid
contact_import_jobs_counts_valid.value:
"contact_import_jobs"."processed_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."created_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."updated_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."unchanged_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."rejected_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."duplicate_rows" >= 0
        and "contact_import_jobs"."processed_rows" <= "contact_import_jobs"."total_rows"
        and "contact_import_jobs"."processed_rows" = "contact_import_jobs"."created_rows"
          + "contact_import_jobs"."updated_rows"
          + "contact_import_jobs"."unchanged_rows"
          + "contact_import_jobs"."rejected_rows"
          + "contact_import_jobs"."duplicate_rows"

contact_import_jobs_completion_consisten.name: contact_import_jobs_completion_consistent
contact_import_jobs_completion_consisten.value:
(
        "contact_import_jobs"."status" = 'processing'
        and "contact_import_jobs"."completed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "contact_import_jobs"."status" = 'completed'
        and "contact_import_jobs"."processed_rows" = "contact_import_jobs"."total_rows"
        and "contact_import_jobs"."completed_at" is not null
      )

contact_import_rows_outcome_consistent.name: contact_import_rows_outcome_consistent
contact_import_rows_outcome_consistent.value:
(
        "contact_import_rows"."status" in ('created', 'updated', 'unchanged')
        and "contact_import_rows"."contact_id" is not null
        and "contact_import_rows"."phone_fingerprint" is not null
        and "contact_import_rows"."reason" is null
      ) or (
        "contact_import_rows"."status" = 'duplicate'
        and "contact_import_rows"."phone_fingerprint" is not null
        and "contact_import_rows"."reason" = 'duplicate_in_file'
      ) or (
        "contact_import_rows"."status" = 'rejected'
        and "contact_import_rows"."contact_id" is null
        and "contact_import_rows"."phone_fingerprint" is null
        and "contact_import_rows"."reason" in ('missing_phone', 'invalid_phone')
      )

contacts_phone_e164_valid.name: contacts_phone_e164_valid
contacts_phone_e164_valid.value:
length("contacts"."phone_e164") between 2 and 16
        and substr("contacts"."phone_e164", 1, 1) = '+'
        and substr("contacts"."phone_e164", 2, 1) between '1' and '9'
        and substr("contacts"."phone_e164", 2) not glob '*[^0-9]*'

contacts_consent_state_consistent.name: contacts_consent_state_consistent
contacts_consent_state_consistent.value:
(
        "contacts"."consent_status" = 'unknown'
        and "contacts"."mailing_status" = 'unsubscribed'
        and "contacts"."consent_source" is null
        and "contacts"."consent_recorded_at" is null
        and "contacts"."consent_withdrawn_at" is null
      ) or (
        "contacts"."consent_status" = 'granted'
        and "contacts"."mailing_status" = 'subscribed'
        and "contacts"."consent_source" is not null
        and "contacts"."consent_recorded_at" is not null
        and "contacts"."consent_withdrawn_at" is null
      ) or (
        "contacts"."consent_status" = 'withdrawn'
        and "contacts"."mailing_status" = 'unsubscribed'
        and "contacts"."consent_source" is not null
        and "contacts"."consent_recorded_at" is not null
        and "contacts"."consent_withdrawn_at" is not null
      )

conversations_last_message_key_valid.name: conversations_last_message_key_valid
conversations_last_message_key_valid.value:
"conversations"."last_message_key" is null
        or (
          length("conversations"."last_message_key") = 75
          and substr("conversations"."last_message_key", 1, 11) = 'message_v1_'
          and substr("conversations"."last_message_key", 12) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        )

conversations_last_message_at_valid.name: conversations_last_message_at_valid
conversations_last_message_at_valid.value:
"conversations"."last_message_at" is null
        or (
          length("conversations"."last_message_at") = 24
          and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "conversations"."last_message_at")
            = "conversations"."last_message_at"
        )

conversations_last_message_pair_consiste.name: conversations_last_message_pair_consistent
conversations_last_message_pair_consiste.value:
(

        and "conversations"."last_message_at" is not null
      )

        "message_templates"."last_status_event_key" is null
        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_at" is null
      ) or (

        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_at" is not null
      )

message_templates_lifecycle_consistent.name: message_templates_lifecycle_consistent
message_templates_lifecycle_consistent.value:
(
        "message_templates"."status" = 'draft'
        and "message_templates"."meta_template_id" is null
        and "message_templates"."submission_key" is null
        and "message_templates"."submission_started_at" is null
        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_key" is null
        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_at" is null
        and "message_templates"."submitted_at" is null
        and "message_templates"."reviewed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "message_templates"."status" = 'submitting'
        and "message_templates"."meta_template_id" is null
        and "message_templates"."submission_key" is not null
        and "message_templates"."submission_started_at" is not null
        and "message_templates"."last_submission_error_code" is null
        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_key" is null
        and "message_templates"."last_status_event_at" is null
        and "message_templates"."submitted_at" is null
        and "message_templates"."reviewed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "message_templates"."status" = 'pending_review'
        and "message_templates"."meta_template_id" is not null
        and "message_templates"."submission_key" is not null
        and "message_templates"."submission_started_at" is not null
        and "message_templates"."last_submission_error_code" is null
        and "message_templates"."submitted_at" is not null
        and "message_templates"."reviewed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "message_templates"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected', 'disabled', 'deleted')
        and "message_templates"."meta_template_id" is not null
        and "message_templates"."submission_key" is not null
        and "message_templates"."submission_started_at" is not null
        and "message_templates"."last_submission_error_code" is null
        and "message_templates"."submitted_at" is not null
        and "message_templates"."reviewed_at" is not null
      )

      ) or (
        "meta_connections"."status" = 'connected'
        and "meta_connections"."webhook_subscribed_at" is not null
        and "meta_connections"."connected_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "meta_connections"."status" in ('verification_required', 'revoked', 'error', 'restricted')
      )

meta_webhook_receipts_state_consistent.value:
(
        "meta_webhook_receipts"."status" = 'processing'
        and "meta_webhook_receipts"."processed_at" is null
        and "meta_webhook_receipts"."last_error_code" is null
      ) or (
        "meta_webhook_receipts"."status" = 'processed'
        and "meta_webhook_receipts"."processed_at" is not null
        and "meta_webhook_receipts"."last_error_code" is null
